verdict.rationale: The portal offers a public lookup of customs-clearance information for a postal parcel (docs-4), which is a narrow form of case-status visibility. Nothing shows a founder can check the status of a tax filing, application, or case from public pages, and the portal's services sit behind registration and login (docs-5). The electronic-notification features (docs-1, docs-2) cover receiving communications, not looking up status. missing for 10: public status lookup for tax filings, applications or cases; evidence that status is reachable without login; documentation of the status-tracking flow; independent or hands-on corroboration.
